name: quick-xml-scoped-space
instr:
Please add scoped `xml:space` handling and bounded text-content extraction to quick-xml in `/app`, without adding crates.

Add `quick_xml::reader::Config::respect_xml_space: bool`, default `false`; `quick_xml::events::XmlSpace::{Default, Preserve}` implementing `Debug + Clone + Copy + PartialEq + Eq`; and `quick_xml::events::BytesStart::xml_space(&self) -> quick_xml::Result<Option<XmlSpace>>`. Return the first exact `xml:space` attribute, ignoring aliases, case variations and unrelated values. Apply XML 1.0 attribute normalization without trimming: `default`/`preserve` select variants; absence returns `None`. Report preceding malformed attributes as `Error::InvalidAttr`, invalid references as `Error::Escape`, and other normalized values as `Error::IllFormed(quick_xml::errors::IllFormedError::InvalidXmlSpace(String))`, containing that value. Ignore subsequent attributes.

When enabled, `preserve` disables both trimming directions, including whitespace-only text and text before EOF; `default` uses current trimming flags. Missing attributes inherit; outside elements use `default`. Never rewrite flags. Track valid policies while disabled; invalid policies then inherit silently. Enabled opening events report accessor errors; recoverable invalid values open inherited scopes. Empty elements cannot leak policies; expanded empties unwind on synthetic ends. Closing tags unwind one scope even on name-mismatch recovery; unmatched closes cannot underflow. Clones copy scopes independently.
